annotations.text:
ROW 1 — the front door.
Desktop and mobile homepage, plus the audit tool.

Anything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a real fact I don't have yet — phone number, address, registration numbers, Joline's testimonial. Nothing is invented.

THIS ONE WORKS.
Tick the seven checks and the score, the band, the colour and the recommended package all recalculate live. Try dropping below 4 — that is the only place the red is allowed to appear.

ROW 2 — how a buyer navigates.
Capabilities (all eight services with prices), one service detail as the pattern for the other eight, and one sector page as the pattern for the other four.

ROW 3 — proof and contact.
Credentials is the page that wins tenders. It lists every document a procurement team checks, with its status shown honestly — [PENDING] where the certificate isn't held yet.

The design system, extended from the brand locked on 8 September.
No new colour, no second typeface. What's added is what a website needs and a social post never did: interaction states, form controls, a spacing scale, and contrast ratios computed rather than assumed.
